title: Liquid C2 and Graphiant Launch Managed Post-Quantum Network-as-a-Service Across Africa - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Cassava Technologies' Liquid C2 and Graphiant launched a managed Quantum Secure Network-as-a-Service across Africa that embeds NIST PQC (ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA) in the transport layer to counter harvest-now, decrypt-later attacks without app-by-app remediation. It also adds AI-agent governance and country-level routing to steer regulated workloads onto Cassava AI Factories under data-sovereignty rules.

insights.claim: Liquid C2, the cloud and cybersecurity subsidiary of Cassava Technologies, has partnered with U.S.-based AI networking vendor Graphiant to deliver a managed Quantum Secure Network-as-a-Service (NaaS) across African enterprise and public-sector infrastructure.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Post-quantum security is being commercialized in emerging markets via telco/cloud partnerships; watch Cassava-group and Graphiant traction as early PQC-NaaS demand signals.
insights.quote: Liquid C2, the cloud and cybersecurity subsidiary of Cassava Technologies, has partnered with U.S.-based AI networking vendor Graphiant
insights.locator: Liquid C2, the cloud and cybersecurity subsidiary

insights.claim: A managed post-quantum network service lets organizations defend against harvest-now, decrypt-later attacks without remediating thousands of legacy applications individually, by embedding post-quantum cryptography in the transport layer linking branches, data centers, cloud and partners.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Network-layer PQC is positioned as a shortcut around costly app-by-app crypto migration, a potential wedge for network vendors versus application-security vendors.
insights.quote: Rather than forcing organizations to remediate thousands of legacy applications individually against harvest-now, decrypt-later attacks
insights.locator: Rather than forcing organizations to remediate

insights.claim: The Liquid C2/Graphiant service builds quantum-resistant tunnels on Graphiant's stateless edge-to-core networking architecture using NIST Security Level 5 ML-KEM-1024 key encapsulation and FIPS 204 ML-DSA authentication.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Adoption of the highest NIST security level and standardized algorithms shows commercial PQC deployments are converging on NIST standards.
insights.quote: NIST Security Level 5 ML-KEM-1024 key encapsulation alongside FIPS 204 ML-DSA authentication

insights.claim: Centralizing cryptographic agility in the network fabric allows enterprises to rotate post-quantum algorithms across connected endpoints as standards evolve without rewriting application code.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Crypto-agility as a managed network feature reduces lock-in risk to any single PQC algorithm; a selling point for network-fabric PQC vendors.
insights.locator: Centralizing cryptographic agility at the network fabric

themes.theme: AI agent governance and data sovereignty

insights.claim: The Liquid C2/Graphiant offering also targets governance risks from autonomous AI agents and connected devices, using network-level session tracing and destination policies to restrict lateral movement by compromised agents.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Network vendors are bundling AI-agent security with PQC, signaling agentic AI is becoming a driver of network-security spend.
insights.quote: restrict lateral movement by compromised agents
insights.locator: The offering also addresses governance risks

insights.claim: Country-level path enforcement and auditable transit logs in the Liquid C2/Graphiant service let regulated finance, government and healthcare organizations route sensitive workloads onto Cassava AI Factories under strict data-sovereignty mandates.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Data-sovereignty rules in Africa create a captive channel for Cassava's in-region AI compute; the network service doubles as a funnel into Cassava AI Factories.
insights.locator: The offering also addresses governance risks
